book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Lasaro la uvara
Urie, non migana bonim a Lasaro la tafaong ga man unama. Iriro migana la irie onim na pianam Betania ga amaning narain laupien la lionama ga irie, Mata ga Maria.
Maria, urie magabun la aurukieng sada bo kibapien a Ila Kakani ga leba ila kibapien a ma kavurup o. Tie papa liang Lasaro, la tafaong.
Are ratmat ga loupien angan la osagaliong ties me ai Iesu. Ligama, “Ila Kakani, iriro migana la mitara nanung aime, la tafaong.”

Upto Iesu uriro ties ga ugama, “Tala kan inamua uriro tafa ga aving. Karuk. Pa eba makosarieng teip ga magaulap ga eba maialang bonim ula kakanu aun Morowa, met iriro paga eba aving Poi ang Morowa bonim a ula kakanu.”
Eva, mitara naong Iesu me Mata, Maria ga papa liang, Lasaro.
Pa tara la upto ties a Lasaro la amaning tafa ula kakanu, tale ula kakalait agimaong. Karuk. Pa man unama ka lie narain lapien na uriro pianam la man unama una.
Ga tubiat la maulo lop o usingnualap, “Ina terigibuong me na provins Iudaia.”
Megama lop o usingnualap aime, “Migana o usingnualap, tinan it kirat la namo novuremeng Iudaiap ma tadasip, pa nuga gat ina nala na irie nap, a?”
Upulo Iesu, ties maiong gare ro “Baraba burau me Iudaiap. Atabo karuk kan a 12 o muabari, a? Leba amung migana ba na efan, tala kan ulum. Muana la ogimaong alang o ileng o uro kimanam.
Pa migana la unum na arubu ume ulum. Memani, tale amaning lalabie meba asingiala o alang.”
Tiesong gare ro, urie tubiat, inagat maulo, “Migan buang Lasaro la duriong ara. Pa eba rala meba temung.”
Lop o usingnualap la mepto uriro ties ga amelo Iesu gare ro, “Ila Kakani, leba duriang ebat ina mumuri ba.”
Pa Iesu la tiesong aime Lasaro la uvara. Pa lop o usingnualap la agatmeng namo ga tiesong ara Iesu aime la duriong it.
Are ratmat ga tiesong Iesu la uakap mai gare ro, “Lasaro la uvara ra.
“Pa agattung me milam ga teruba muana la tale tunama ga mirie, meba naganming. Pa titot la eba bula ai.”
Tomas, meiva Didimas, maulo non lop o usingnualap gare ro, “Tie, bula meba buving ga Ila Kakani.”
Ugama Iesu, “Tenuarap la turuo kan ga ninimiap la turuo kan.”
Tie, Iesu ga lop am o usingnualap la mela betmeng kagarat u pianam Betania ga upto Iesu ties gare ro nagala ra ma lap la ut Lasaro na una.
Betania la iot kagarat u Ierusalem, puieng gare naien kilometavien.
Ga papot ma Iudaiap la mumaio u Mata ga Maria meba maidangmeng maset dalap lie. Memani, papaliang, la uvara.
Na tara la ipto Mata ties aime Iesu la unum ga muo, tie teiara ga ila abolaieng. Pa Maria la man ionamat na luguan.
Muio Mata ga ailo Iesu, “Ila Kakani, la nunama ro, tala kan uvara Lasaro.
Pa titot gat la tira maset, leba mariknang me ai Morowa me paga ba, tie eba alang Morowa noun.”
Iesu la oulo Mata, “Eba ina emung papa nuang.”
Pa ailo Mata, “Arit eba ina teara na iriro tara teip ga magaulap ganam leba ina temaiara na una na tara lagorang.”
Pa oulo Iesu Mata, “Turuo kan tenuarap ga turuo kan ninimiap. Man migana la naganong ira ruo, la eba aving, eba ina emung.
Pa mirier teip ga magaulap la maionama ga meinim ga naganmeng me ties tung. Tala kan mevara. Karuk. Eba maionang ga meimung mar mirie lap. Mata, nagannung gare tiro o karuk?”
Pa ailo Mata Iesu, “Eva, Ila Kakani, nagantung nunuo Karisito. Nunuo Poi ang Morowa, irie la asagaong ga muo na uro kimanam.”
Iesu la uliba

Mata la tiesieng ara ga Iesu, tie ila omarikieng papa ieng, Maria. Olagieng ga ila na taralap ga oilo tigit Maria. Igama, “Migana o usingnualap isik la muo ra, ga tomarikong nunuo lagum la nunama. Nala agimanang.”
Maria la ipto uriro ties ga teiara, ga kakalait ila ai Iesu.
Tale ka betong Iesu na luguan maiang. Unama ka na iriro nap la lake abolaieng Mata.
Pa Iudaiap la man maionama na luguan ga Maria ga man kadikmeng ga urie. Ogimameng la kakalait teiara ga ila lavie. Ga omeuluo. Agatmeng namo ga er ila iliba na una.
Tie, ila Maria betieng na iriro nap la unama Iesu ana, ga agimaieng Iesu. Are ratmat ga makofieng dadebip o ai kiban a ga igama, “Ila Kakani, la nunama togo, tala kan uvara papa ruang.”
Ogimaong Iesu la iliba ga magimaong inamaniap la mumaio ga urie, mirie gat la meliba. Ga dalap a la kadikmeng maset.
Ga mamarikong, “Lagum la miabua?” Ga amelo, “Ila Kakani munang agimanang.”
Iesu la uliba.
Are ratmat ga megama Iudaiap, “Agimaming la uliba. Mitara naong me Lasaro!”
Pa mirie la megama, “Iriro migana la unavam irap ma inamaniap mila sapsapmeng. Atabo tale kan puoong meba aagaalie iriro migana meba tale aving, a?”
Iesu la ina imua Lasaro

Tie, upto Iesu uriro ties ga dalap a la kadikmeng maset. Are ratmat ga unum Kagarat ai iriro una. Iriro lu la akosarmeng inamaniap tapma na tadas ila kakani. Ga ame non tadas la mime mialua nanam a iriro lu.

Ga maulo Iesu, “Avugutmiara iriro tadas.” Pa turupiaba Mata kirat ga ailo Iesu, “Ila Kakani, kiro la eba okosarnang gare tiro. Uvara ga nagala ma lap la aipmeng ara. Are ratmat ga betieng ara isanim ula kiro.”
Pa oulo Iesu Mata, “Lake la norulo ra, ‘Leba nagannang ira ruo, tie eba agimanang lalabie ila kakani ga ngangas ang Morowa.’”
Urie, avukutmiara iriro tadas na nanam a iriro una. Ga ui Iesu me nakap na panbinim ga ugama, “Mamo, tivo temaieng me noi. Memani, nupto ra marik tung.

Norit ara nume busit nupto marik tung. Pa agattung me teip ga magaulap mirogo la dusmeng togo ga tuaramo uriro ties. Memani, meba naganmeng ira nuo la tosaganung ga muruo na uro kimanam na tara la agimameng paga la betong titot.”
Tiesong gare tiro ga marikong maranit. “Lasaro, tenara ga munang lavie!”

Urie, talet kagat, iriro migana la uvara la teuara ga muo lavie! Levismeng kilalapien a ga kibapien a a buruma o nuvarap. Ga maialuan gat irapien a a buruma. Are ratmat ga ugama Iesu, “Mila mavikming miriro burap ira a ga miairang meba ala.”
Teip mila kakanim onim Iudaia la meburio ties meba menamung Iesu ga aving
Urie, papot ma teip ga magaulap onim Iudaia la mumaio kadikmeng ga Maria la agimameng Iesu la akosarong iriro paga, ga naganmeng ira a la irie Karisito.
Pa non ma mirie la mela mai Parasaiop ga mamelo a iriro paga la akosarong Iesu.

Are ratmat ga Parasaiop ga miridaip mila kakanim la marikmeng me teip a kaunsel ga mumaio nebolameng ga mamelo gare ro, “Eba mani le akosarbuong, a? Iriro migana la mitara makosarong papot ma kagup onim na panbinim.

Leba buairang aun iriro tavuk la man akosarong, mirier teip ga magaulap ganam leba naganmeng iro ties ang ga eba ameuluan. Ga tubiat teip o danunumiap onim Rom leba mumaiong ga akirarameng luguan buang o lotu ga mirier garip buam.”
Pa non migana kabirana ma, bonim a Kaiafas, irie miridai ila uke na urie karanim, la ugama maime, “Tale kan amit paga ba!
Atabo tale kan amit non tavuk la puoong meba buagaalie. Temaieng let namurit ba migana le aving meba maagaalie teip ga magaulap ganam. Babun mirier garip buam ganam leba ioumeng.”
Tale kan tiesong gare tiro o agat kan ang. Karuk. Irie miridai na urie karanim. Are ratmat ga tiesong gare unuli me Iesu le aving meba maagaalie teip ga magaulap onim Iudaia.
Iesu la talet uvara me teip ga magaulap onim Iudaia meba maagaalie. Karuk. Uvara meba apamum mirier teip ga magaulap am Morowa la maionama tapmat ga eba betmeng gare namurit gar.
Tie, na uriro la, teip mila kakanim la pumaiaro ga meburio ties meba oisinmeng alang ba meba menamung Iesu ga aving.

Are ratmat ga tale gat ume unum Iesu la uakap kabirana ma Iudaiap. Karuk. Oulai uriro pianam ga ula unama kagarat u pianam la karuk ma inamaniap, na non taun la meivo bonim o Epraim. Ga man unama na uriro taun ga lop am o usingnualap.

Uriro la ula babau o ula aipieng maiong Iudaiap kagarat ara la namo betieng. Are ratmat ga papot teip ga magaulap onim na pialap tapmat la mela na taun Ierusalem meba tebabaurameng kan lake me la ula babau.
Ga namo aisinmeng Iesu. Man dusmeng tapma na luguan o lotu ga man nemarikmeng kabirana ma kan gare ro, “Agatbuong gare mani? Atabo eba muong ogimaang la ula babau o ula aipieng o karuk?”
Pa Miridaip mila kakanim ga Parasaiop la mamelo teip ga magaulap gare ro, “Migana ba la ait Iesu la unama lagum, tie, tiesnang meba uparing a ga avispang.”

footnotes.text: Mata la ait tara la muo betong Iesu na luguan, papot teip ga magaulap la namo agimameng. Are ratmat ga oilo Maria tigit it poieng ba lake ila agimaieng lake ga mela bat abolameng teip ga magaulap.
